Name: Operating checking
Notes: Card batches, delivery payouts and most bills

Name: Payroll checking
Notes: Optional. Funded from operating before each pay run

Name: Cash on hand
Notes: Registers and safe. Count at close on the last night of the month

Name: Delivery app payouts receivable
Notes: Orders taken by delivery apps and not yet paid out at month end

Name: Food inventory
Notes: Counted at cost on the last night of the month

Name: Beverage inventory
Notes: Bar and drinks, counted apart from food

Name: Prepaid expenses
Notes: Insurance, licenses and rent paid ahead

Name: Kitchen equipment
Notes: Ranges, walk-ins and dish machines at cost

Name: Leasehold improvements
Notes: Build-out in a rented space, depreciated over the shorter of the lease or the useful life

Name: Accumulated depreciation
Notes: Contra account; carries a credit balance

Name: Accounts payable
Notes: Distributor invoices on terms, entered as bills so the later payment matches

Name: Tips payable
Notes: Card tips owed to staff. Credited when the deposit is recorded, cleared through payroll; should fall close to zero each pay period

Name: Sales tax payable
Notes: Tax collected on taxable sales, owed to the state. Paying it clears this line; it is not an expense

Name: Gift cards outstanding
Notes: Cards sold and not yet redeemed. The sale is recorded when the card pays for a meal

Name: Payroll liabilities
Notes: Withholdings and employer taxes, from the payroll register

Name: Business credit card
Notes: Charges on the card; the payment from checking is a transfer, not an expense

Name: Equipment loan
Notes: Split each payment between this line and interest expense

Name: Owner capital
Notes: Money the owner put in

Name: Owner draws
Notes: Money the owner took out, and personal spending on business cards

Name: Retained earnings
Notes: Prior years' profit; usually maintained by the software

Name: Food sales
Notes: Pre-tax food sales from the POS daily total

Name: Beverage sales
Notes: Split into liquor, beer and wine children if the bar is a large part of the business

Name: Delivery app sales
Notes: Order subtotals from the payout reports, grossed up for commissions and deductions

Name: Refunds and comps
Notes: Refunds, including delivery app refunds for missing items. Carries a debit balance

Name: Food cost
Notes: Food purchases, adjusted each month for the change in food inventory

Name: Beverage cost
Notes: Drink purchases, adjusted each month for the change in beverage inventory

Name: To-go packaging
Notes: Optional, if you track it apart from paper goods

Name: Kitchen wages
Notes: Gross wages from the payroll register

Name: Front-of-house wages
Notes: Cash wages paid; tips are not wages here

Name: Payroll taxes and benefits
Notes: Employer taxes and benefits. Prime cost is 5010 to 5030 plus 6010 to 6040

Name: Utilities
Notes: Gas, electric, water and trash

Name: Repairs and maintenance
Notes: Hood cleaning, refrigeration and equipment repairs

Name: Smallwares
Notes: Pans, utensils and glassware below the capitalization threshold

Name: Card processing fees
Notes: Merchant fees from the processor statement

Name: Delivery app commissions
Notes: Commissions from the payout reports, booked once a month by journal entry

Name: Marketing
Notes: Includes delivery app promotions you agreed to fund

Name: Insurance
Notes: General liability, liquor liability and property

Name: Licenses and permits
Notes: Health permit, liquor license

Name: Interest expense
Notes: Interest part of loan payments
